headline: Two kinds of no-exam life insurance
points: Simplified issue: a few health questions, no exam
Guaranteed issue: no health questions at all
Guaranteed issue usually pays a reduced benefit in the first years
Ask which one you are being offered, and when the full benefit begins

headline: Four checks before Medicare changes take effect
points: Read the Annual Notice of Change your plan mailed
Confirm every prescription is still on the drug list
Confirm your doctors and hospital are still in network
Confirm your pharmacy is still a good fit
